title.narrative: Improve health of the people of Senegal in a sustainable manner through health community system - Senegal (01-Jan-2021-31-Dec-2023)

description.narrative: Senegal, Multicomponent, Plan International, Inc. (Plan Senegal)This program has the following goals: Contribuer à la reduction des endémies majeures au Senegal / Contributing to the reduction of major endemics in Senegal. Réduire le nombre de décès liés à la tuberculose de 40% à l’horizon de 2023 par rapport à 2015 / Reduce the number of deaths from tuberculosis by 40% by 2023 compared to 2015. Améliorer durablement la santé des populations du Sénégal / Sustainably improve the health of the people of Senegal. The objectives of this program are: Réduire l’incidence du paludisme d’au moins 75% par rapport à 2019 // Reduce malaria incidence by at least 75% compared to 2019. Augmenter le nombre notifié de cas de nouvel épisode de tuberculose à au moins 17 037 en 2023 et maintenir un taux de succès thérapeutique à au moins 90% à partir de 2021 / To increase the reported number of new tuberculosis cases to at least 17,037 in 2023 and to maintain a treatment success rate of at least 90% from 2021 onwards.. Réduire la mortalité liée paludisme d’au moins 75% par rapport à 2019 // Reduce malaria-related mortality by at least 75% compared to 2019. Augmenter de 97 à 194 le nombre de malades mis sous traitement pour une tuberculose multi-résistante ou résistante à la rifampicine et atteindre un taux de succès thérapeutique d'au moins 84 % à l’horizon 2023 / To increase from 97 to 194 the number of patients treated for multi-drug-resistant or rifampicin-resistant tuberculosis and achieve a treatment success rate of at least 84% by 2023.. Interrompre la transmission locale dans au moins 80% des districts éligibles en 2019 // Interrupt local transmission in at least 80% of eligible districts in 2019.. A partir de 2021, assurer le dépistage systématique de l’infection VIH chez 100% des malades tuberculeux notifiés et la mise sous ARV et cotrimoxazole chez 100% des patients co-infectés tuberculose/VIH / From 2021, ensure systematic screening for HIV infection in 100% of notified tuberculosis patients and the initiation of ARV and cotrimoxazole treatment in 100% of tuberculosis/HIV co-infected patients.. Améliorer les capacités techniques et les pratiques de gestion du Programme national de Lutte contre la Tuberculose / To improve the technical capacity and management practices of the National Tuberculosis Control Programme.. Améliorer la collaboration avec le secteur prive , les secteurs ministeriels , les communautés, les organisations de la société civile pour la prévention, le diagnostic et le suivi du traitement de la tuberculose et agir sur les determinants sociaux de la maladie / Improve collaboration with the private sector, ministerial sectors, communities, civil society organizations for the prevention, diagnosis and monitoring of TB treatment and address the social determinants of the disease.. Mettre en place un processus permettant le développement de la recherche opérationnelle en ce qui concerne la prévention, les soins et la lutte contre la tuberculose au Sénégal / Establish a process for the development of operational research on the prevention, care and control of tuberculosis in Senegal.. Atteindre 87% ( 2023) de taux d'achevement de la consultation prénatale / Achieve 87% ( 2023) completion rate of prenatal consultation

TB incidence rate per 100,000 population
TB mortality rate per 100,000 population
In-patient malaria deaths: rate per 100,000 persons per year
Confirmed malaria cases (microscopy or RDT): rate per 1000 persons per year
RR-TB and/or MDR-TB prevalence among new TB patients: Proportion of new TB patients with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB
Outcome indicators targets and results for SEN-Z-PLANP01
Treatment success rate of all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, new and relapse

TB treatment coverage: Percentage of patients with new and relapse TB that were notified and treated among the estimated number of incident TB in the same year (all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed
Treatment success rate of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB: Percentage of patients with RR and/or MDR-TB successfully treated
Proportion of population that slept under an insecticide-treated net the previous night
Proportion of children under five years old who slept under an insecticide-treated net the previous night
Proportion of pregnant women who slept under an insecticide-treated net the previous night
HSS Other-1: Percentage of pregnant women who started their ANC1 and achieved their 4 ANCs according to the standards (ANC completion rate)
Case notification rate of all forms of TB per 100,000 population - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, new and relapse cases
Notification of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB cases – Percentage of notified cases of bacteriologically confirmed, drug resistant RR-TB and/or MDR-TB as a proportion of all estimated RR-TB and/or MDR-TB cases
Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for SEN-Z-PLANP01
Percentage of community based monitoring reports presented to relevant oversight mechanisms
Number of notified TB cases (all forms) contributed by non-national TB program providers - community referrals
Proportion of community health workers who received at least one supportive supervision during the reporting period
Number of long-lasting insecticidal nets distributed to at-risk populations through mass campaigns
